title: Amount in Words
summary: Spells an amount in words and names each digit group, so ₹2,50,000 isn't written or read as ₹25,00,000.
description: Names every digit group (2 lakh · 50 thousand), spells the amount cheque-style in lakh/crore or million with paise or cents, can show the other number system alongside, and checks typed words against the figure.
catches: An extra or missing zero, by naming each digit group
Typed words that do not match the figure, with a one-tap correction
Confusion between lakh/crore and million/billion, via the other system shown alongside
Mismatches that are a power of ten apart ("10× more")
limits: Words are English only, with cheque wording built in for INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED and SGD
Takes the amount as a JavaScript number in major units, so very large values lose precision
Word matching is a text comparison; unusual spellings may be reported as a mismatch
a11y: The grouped figure has an aria-label with the full amount; the visual group labels are aria-hidden
Words input has a <label>, aria-invalid on mismatch and aria-describedby to its status
Match status is aria-live="polite"; a mismatch uses role="alert"
Copy button has an aria-label that changes to "Copied"
